roast.label: Roasting
roast.title: Roast Settings
roast.description: Set the temperature unit, alerts, charge and drop detection, and what the chart shows.
roast.temperatureUnitDescription: Display temperatures in Celsius or Fahrenheit.
roast.fontScaleDescription: Size of the event and phase labels drawn on the chart.
roast.updateRateDescription: How often to poll the machine for temperature data during a live session.
roast.updateRateProHint: The 500ms update rate requires a Pro plan. Upgrade to unlock faster polling.
roast.smoothingHint: 0 is the raw reading. Higher strength is slower and smoother.
roast.rorSpanDescription: Time window for Rate of Rise calculation. Shorter spans react faster; longer spans are smoother.
roast.dataVisibilityDescription: Choose which data series are displayed on the roasting chart.
roast.showTargetCurveDescription: Stored reference. Channels in Profile curves.
roast.profileSeriesDescription: Channels drawn from the stored profile while Target Curve is on. Independent of the live series. Drum, heater, and fan appear when the control chart is on.
roast.showRoRChartDescription: BT RoR sub-chart below the temperature curve
roast.showRoRETDescription: ET RoR sub-chart below the temperature curve
roast.showControlChartDescription: Drum speed, heater output, and fan speed chart
roast.showFcBandDescription: Shade the chart background from FC Start to FC End
roast.eventMarkersDescription: Chart display style for roast events and turning points
roast.eventButtonsDescription: Side buttons during a roast. Turning one off hides only that button.
roast.eventButtonNameInvalid: Use 1–16 characters. Existing names and built-in events are not allowed.
roast.eventButtonLimit: You can add up to 8 events.
roast.eventMarkerPointDescription: Dot on the BT curve with a label box (event, time, temp)
roast.eventMarkerTempLineDescription: Vertical line on the temperature chart only
roast.eventMarkerLineDescription: Vertical line on the temperature chart and the control chart
roast.pidDropBehaviorDescription: What happens to burner output when automatic heat control (PID or Replay) disengages at drop
roast.pidDropHoldDescription: Keeps the burner where it is, so the next batch starts from a hot drum. Faults and over-temp still force heat to zero.
roast.pidDropZeroDescription: Turns the burner off immediately at drop
roast.axisTicksDescription: Applies to live and history charts. Defaults: 10° temperature spacing, labels every 5 steps, and 60-second time spacing. Temperature spacing uses the displayed unit.
roast.customTempTicksDescription: Separate values with commas, e.g. 100, 150, 180. Only values within the axis range appear. Leave empty to use default ticks.
roast.customTempTicksError: Enter up to 100 valid numbers within 0–500°C.
roast.axisRangeDescription: Set the visible range for the temperature, RoR, and time axes. The time axis starts at this length and grows when the roast or profile is longer.
roast.customRorTicksDescription: Separate values with commas, e.g. -5, 0, 5, 10. Only values within the axis range appear. Leave empty to use default ticks.
roast.customRorTicksError: Enter up to 100 valid numbers within −100–300°C/min.
roast.controlChartDescription: Control chart series and axis range. Chart visibility is set under Data Visibility.
roast.controlDrumDescription: Drum RPM series on the control band
roast.controlBandHeightDescription: Control band height as % of the full chart (12–40)
roast.phaseTemperaturesDescription: Auto-mark Yellow when BT crosses the threshold after the turning point. First Crack is always manual.
roast.yellowPointDescription: Auto-mark Yellow when BT crosses this temperature after the turning point
roast.fcMarkingDescription: How the FC button records first crack
roast.fcDualMarkDescription: 1st click: FC Start. 2nd: FC Rolling. 3rd: unmark Rolling. 4th: unmark Start. Off = toggle FC Start (also drops leftover Rolling).
roast.autoChargeSensitiveDescription: Detects weaker declines and is more sensitive to temperature fluctuations.
roast.autoChargeUnavailable: Automatic Charge detection is unavailable. Use manual Charge or restart the app.
roast.bbpDescription: Record temperatures and controls between batches.
roast.autoChargeDescription: Detects when bean temperature turns downward while waiting for Charge. Manual Charge remains available when disabled.
roast.autoDropDescription: Detects when bean temperature turns downward after more than {{minutes}} min (BT above 160°C). Manual Drop remains available when disabled.
roast.autoDropStartDescription: Minutes from Charge. A Drop is marked only after this time is exceeded.
roast.autoDropSensitivityDescription: Detects weaker declines and is more sensitive to temperature fluctuations.
roast.autoDropUnavailable: Automatic Drop detection is unavailable. Use manual Drop or restart the app.
roast.alertsDescription: Threshold warnings and time reminders during the roast.
roast.alertsEnabledDescription: Show a warning banner during the roast.
roast.alertSoundDescription: Beep when an alarm first triggers.
roast.alertSoundKindDescription: Use Preview to check it cuts through the roastery noise.
roast.alertRorCrashDescription: Warn when BT RoR falls to this. Only after the turning point.
roast.alertBtMaxDescription: Warn when bean temperature reaches this.
roast.alertAfterChargeDescription: Remind this many minutes after Charge.
roast.alertBeforeFcDescription: Remind this many minutes before the target profile's FC Start. Needs a target profile with an FC Start mark.
roast.alertBeforeDropDescription: Remind this many minutes before the target profile's Drop. Needs a target profile with a Drop mark.
roast.alertAfterDropDescription: Remind this many minutes after Drop. The timer keeps running until End roast.
roast.curveStylesDescription: Color, width, and line style per channel. Target curves use the same style at reduced opacity. Applies to Active Roast and History.
